Paine Field NDT jobs: which run on SNT-TC-1A, which on NAS 410, and which on a repair station manual

Everett has three kinds of aerospace NDT employer within a few miles of the Paine Field runway, and each reaches its certification rules by a different road. Boeing's widebody factory assembles the 767, the KC-46 tanker and the 777 family, with the Composite Wing Center beside it laying up 777X wing skins and spars. A ring of Snohomish County suppliers machines, finishes and bonds parts for those lines. And heavy-maintenance hangars such as Aviation Technical Services work on airline aircraft under FAA repair station rules.

On the production side

The planemaker runs internal qualification programs for its own inspectors, so anyone aiming at a Boeing NDT posting should read the listing closely and ask the hiring Level 3 what standard the program cites. Its suppliers are a different case. Airframe and engine makers commonly put NAS 410, or EN 4179 on European orders, into the quality clauses of their purchase orders, and the clause flows down to whichever sub-tier shop inspects the part. A small machine shop in Mukilteo or Arlington can end up running a NAS 410 program because of wording drafted two tiers above it. Once invoked, the standard's minimums are contractual, and a Responsible Level 3 (RL3), designated in writing, controls the program.

In the hangars

Maintenance is where SNT-TC-1A and NAS 410 meet a third document. The FAA does not certify NDT personnel. Its advisory circular AC 65-31B lists NAS 410, ATA Specification 105, SNT-TC-1A, ISO 9712 and others as acceptable, and each repair station follows the standard written into its own repair station manual and its customers' contracts. A technician who moves from a Paine Field hangar to a supplier, or the other way, should expect to be examined and certified again. Eddy current around fasteners and penetrant on fittings dominate hangar work; the aviation eddy current guide explains why.

Questions an Everett technician should settle early

  • Is the job on the assembly line, at a supplier, or in a hangar? The answer usually predicts the document.
  • Does the written practice name NAS 410, ATA 105 or SNT-TC-1A, and which revision or edition?
  • If you trained at the WATR Center or a college program, will the RL3 accept that course outline and its hours?
  • Are your magnetic particle and penetrant hours formally documented? NAS 410 expects more formal surface-method training than SNT-TC-1A recommends, and that is where most newcomers fall short.
  • Do you hold copies of your experience log, examination results and vision record? They are the only part of a certification that leaves with you.

For Snohomish County suppliers and repair stations

A supplier that ships parts under a NAS 410 clause and also takes industrial work can run both schemes, provided every certification letter states which standard and revision it was issued under. Revision 6, released in December 2025, is the current NAS 410; update the written practice, training material and examination banks together once your customers set a date. Nadcap AC7114 auditors read real personnel files, and a repair station's own auditors do the same against its manual. Atlantis prepares and reviews NAS 410 and Nadcap AC7114 audit documentation for your RL3 to approve; the RL3 role stays inside your company.

Atlantis and Paine Field employers

For aerospace and aviation companies in Everett, the Atlantis offer is ASNT NDT Level III consulting, SNT-TC-1A-based training, and UT, MT, PT and VT inspection. Training runs as self-paced online theory, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions, plus rehearsal in the Practical NDT simulator and its aviation workplace; the hands-on work and practical examination happen in your own shop or hangar under your written practice. Atlantis has no classroom in Everett. Consulting covers written practices built on SNT-TC-1A and aligned with customer flow-down and Nadcap AC7114, procedures, Level I and II examinations and outside agency ASNT Level III services. For Paine Field shops, Atlantis does not provide NAS 410 training, certification, examinations or a Responsible Level 3. Before anyone enrolls in outside training meant to count toward NAS 410 certification, the employer's RL3 should confirm it will be credited. The side-by-side NAS 410 and SNT-TC-1A guide and the aviation NDT training page go further, and the Seattle page covers the King County supply chain.
